details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:240-245 (map_entry inherited branch, `if not names and path_entries == 1: matched = True`; path_counts plumbing in cmd_map) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: An inherited single-entry unit with no parsed names is now classified as not_reproduced/pre_existing, so a test node that is missing on both trees (pytest exit 4/5) is read as "fails at the failing SHA".
  WHY: Inherited gate entries carry no rc or tail (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:946), and classify_baseline keeps exit-4/5-on-both-trees units as inherited. A test that the heal itself adds therefore passes run 1 and "fails" run 2, cmd_final returns outcome=fixed, and the `[repro-required]` gate passes with no real reproduction. This case used to be held as unverified/names_incomplete (exit 43), and the new test test_inherited_sole_named_entry_without_parsed_names_is_pre_existing pins the bypass in place. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:653-688 (_verify_one `if [ "${marker_rc}" -eq 2 ]` branch at 657-663, returning 0 before the escalation block at 678-688) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When both comment POSTs fail and `_recurred_marker_landed` returns 2 (inconclusive), the branch logs a WARNING and returns 0. It skips the `prior_recurred >= 1` escalation (the ai:workflow-heal-escalated label and the CRITICAL alert).
  WHY: The heal stays open and later ticks select only closed heals (cmd_select, lines 226-341), so the second-recurrence escalation required by plan P7 is lost for good. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy) vs workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py; parity assertion tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:45-53 (test_live_copies_match_their_templates, line 49) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR changes the template hook (`run --tests-file`, parse_tests_file, classify_baseline exit-4/5 handling) but does not sync the committed live copy, so the live/template parity assertion fails.
  WHY: The tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check on head b012532e (run 41350293892) is red with "Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py". CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA is empty, so the pending-sync exemption does not apply. Per agents.md this drift also blocks the stable release. Severity is disputed: sonnet, gemini and glm rated it BLOCKER; minimax and luna rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:49-53 (header "Per examined heal at most 3 REST reads") vs 450-451 (_recurred_marker_landed TOTAL_READS increment and the comments GET); MAX_READS_PER_HEAL line 79 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new error-path confirmation read is a fourth REST read per heal (glm adds that the reclose at 669-670 is a fourth write), but the header's API-budget contract and MAX_READS_PER_HEAL do not account for it.
  WHY: The script's own CLAUDE.md §14 budget documentation now understates the real worst case. Only agents.d/heal-verify.md was updated. There is no functional failure.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh (heal_repro_git() helper) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The helper runs the git binary found on PATH instead of an absolute path.
  WHY: A compromised environment could run a malicious git binary inside the credential-free gate container. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this as not demonstrable because PATH is the runner's own.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh (heal_repro_inner_finish()) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The helper exits 0 after calling the map function, even when the map fails.
  WHY: This masks map-phase errors and makes reproduction failures harder to debug. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it: always exiting 0 is the documented contract, the map failure is logged, and the parent maps a missing or invalid repro.json to inner_failed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Committed live copies of `.claude/hooks/**` security hooks must match their templates for CI to pass "even when the editor cannot write the live file" (agents.md:3014-3016). Plan P2 step 1 adds `run --tests-file` to workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:224).
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (a byte-for-byte copy of the template with its mode preserved), or an entry in .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json naming the pending sync
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither file appears in pr_changed_files.txt or the last-run changed files, and no PR or last-run hunk touches them. The live run_parser (.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1378-1382) has no `--tests-file`, while the template's does (line 1548). grep shows 0 `tests_file` matches in the live file against 32+ in the template. The tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check on b012532e (run 41350293892) fails on this drift. Two earlier autofix rounds deferred it as "sandbox-excluded", which agents.md:3016 rules out. Severity: BLOCKER from sonnet and glm, MAJOR from minimax.
- requirement: The heal reproduction runner (P2 of docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md, Refs #8434) should be wired into the intake and editor jobs.
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh and scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Gemini says the diff of scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh only sets environment variables and never triggers heal_reproduce.sh (severity BLOCKER). Two reviewers refute this: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash point to `_heal_run_reproduction`, defined at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3349, invoked at :3466, and resolving or calling heal_reproduce.sh at :3425, behind WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPRODUCE_ENABLED (line 352). heal_isolated_implement.sh calls it in heal_impl_repro_check.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:map_entry inherited branch ("if not names and path_entries == 1: matched = True"; path_counts.get(test_path, 1) in cmd_map) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A test the heal adds itself can pass the `[repro-required]` gate. An inherited unit with no names is treated as proof of failure on both trees, and a node missing on both trees (exit 4/5) is indistinguishable from a setup ERROR (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:946, 849-853).
  WHY: Run 1 shows the test passing on the edited tree and run 2 (`--sha <failing> --baseline <failing>`) returns not_reproduced/pre_existing, so cmd_final writes outcome=fixed with no exit 43. partial_delivery._heal_counterfactual_repro_tests checks only the id grammar. test_inherited_sole_named_entry_without_parsed_names_is_pre_existing pins the behaviour. Fix: drop the override, or require the gate to emit rc and exclude exit 4/5.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:657-663 (rc==2 branch) vs 678-688 (escalation) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rc=2 path leaves the reopened heal open with only a WARNING and skips the escalation label and CRITICAL alert when prior_recurred >= 1.
  WHY: Later ticks list closed heals only (comment at lines 665-668), so the P7 escalation (agents.d/heal-verify.md) is lost. Fix: run the escalation in the rc==2 branch (~6 lines).
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy) vs workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py; tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:49 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template changes but the live copy does not, so the parity assertion fails (run 41350293892, head b012532e). CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA is empty.
  WHY: CI is red now and the drift blocks the stable release. Two autofix runs deferred it. It needs a trusted sync or a claude_template_divergence.json entry.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:50-52 header vs 450-451 (_recurred_marker_landed); MAX_READS_PER_HEAL line 79 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The fourth error-path read is not reflected in the "at most 3 reads" header or in the cap.
  WHY: The §14 budget contract understates the worst case. Fix: add a one-clause exception to the header.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: live `.claude/hooks/**` copies must match their templates, and P2 step 1 adds `run --tests-file` to the template. Expected change site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, or a .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json entry. Evidence of absence: neither file is in pr_changed_files.txt, and the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator check on b012532e fails on this drift. SEVERITY: BLOCKER. ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Rejected pass-1 items (3 related items): the gemini TASK_GAP on intake wiring is wrong (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh defines _heal_run_reproduction at :3349 and resolves the helper at :3425). The gemini "$2 expansion" and PATH-git items are not demonstrable. The gemini heal_repro_inner_finish exit-0 item is the documented contract.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items), HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3:
  - scripts/heal_reproduce.sh map_entry: remove the no-names override and update the test (6 lines).
  - scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh marker_rc==2: run the escalation in that branch (6 lines).
  - scripts/heal_reproduce.sh cmd_map: write `tmp = out + ".tmp"` with mode 0o600 via os.open/os.fdopen (3 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (live copy vs workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR modifies the template hook but does not sync the live copy.
  WHY: The tests-hooks-and-orchestrator parity check fails, which blocks the stable release gate.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:heal_repro_git() | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The helper uses git from PATH instead of an absolute path.
  WHY: A compromised environment could run a malicious git inside the gate container.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:653-688 (_recurred_marker_landed) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function returns 0 when the comment read fails or is ambiguous, which skips escalation.
  WHY: The ai:workflow-heal-escalated label and the critical alerts are skipped, so recurrent fixes go unmanaged.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:map_entry | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Inherited tests with no parsed names are classified incorrectly.
  WHY: A unit with no names may be a setup error, but it is classified as pre-existing, so the check returns fixed/fixed and bypasses the reproduction requirement.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:heal_repro_inner_finish() | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The helper exits 0 even when the map fails.
  WHY: This masks map-phase errors.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh (header contract vs actual API reads) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The header documents "at most 3 REST reads", but the error path adds a fourth.
  WHY: This understates the API budget and v
